note: Design v1 for the nasal-cilia x weak DC field experiment (cilia/PROTOCOL.md). Structure fixed now; the smallest effect of interest and the number of sessions are fixed after the baseline phase, in design_v2.
field_set_by: current: I = sigma * E * A (Ringer's sigma ~1.5 S/m at 22-25 C); 75 uA for 1 V/cm in a 5 mm x 0.1 mm channel
primary_outcome: clump drift along the field axis, FWD minus REV, in live clumps minus the same contrast in dead (heat-killed) clumps from the same sample
secondary_outcomes: rotation FWD minus REV (live minus dead)
CBF FWD minus SHAM and REV minus SHAM (live)
analysis: per clump paired changes from the preceding OFF epoch; live vs dead two-sample permutation on the primary; sign-flip tests for secondaries; two-sided alpha 0.05 primary, secondaries descriptive
temperature: logged at start and end of every clump; a clump whose temperature changes by more than 1.0 C during its epochs is excluded
medium: home Ringer's with Ca2+ (PROTOCOL section 1); sigma 1.5 S/m
hand_check: every tenth clip counted by hand for CBF; FFT readings that differ by more than 20% are replaced by the hand count and flagged
